title: OTInstaller shared results, version 1
description: What `ot share` and `otlite share` upload to POST /v1/shares: one or more saved runs, as their result envelopes without the details that only mean something on the sharer's machine (file paths, case name, command line, run id). Anyone with the link can read it for 24 hours. Fields are only ever added within version 1, so readers must ignore keys they don't know.

source.description: The program that saved the runs.

run.description: One run's envelope (https://otinstaller.com/schema/envelope-v1.json for ot; otlite's has no raw or run_id and adds status). The registry drops run_id, case, command, target, stderr_path, output.path and output.meta_path if they are sent.

tool.description: namespace/name@version for ot, name@version for otlite.

runtime.description: docker or pipx for ot, otlite for otlite.

input.description: The inputs the run was given, by input name (otlite: target).

status.description: otlite: complete, failed, timeout or interrupted.

raw.description: The tool's output: parsed by its output_format for ot (null when left out), the text for otlite.
